label.purpose: Filters, table headers, and evidence labels.

motion.name: state-only
motion.purpose: Connection and selection feedback only; reduced-motion safe.

breakpoints.name: minimum-window
breakpoints.purpose: Below this width, preserve the table and filter deck with horizontal scrolling.

narrative.overview: A dense native macOS DX operations surface whose dark tonal layers keep attention on callsigns, frequencies, and evidence-backed status. OM0RX semantic colors remain consistent across the stream, history, matrix, and settings.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Never reuse a call or DXCC status color decoratively in a way that changes its meaning.

rules.name: The Dual-Evidence Rule
rules.body: LoTW upload and confirmation arrows are independent and turn green only for their own true state.

dos: Keep filters in one horizontal row.
Use explicit dashes for untouched matrix cells.
donts: Do not replace status text with color alone.
Do not add gradients, glow, or dashboard whitespace.
